scenes.name: Particle field
scenes.description: A drifting cloud of points on one shared canvas. Density, drift speed and accent colour are driven by tokens, so the scene reads as ambient depth behind hero or CTA copy.

scenes.name: Floating shapes
scenes.description: A small set of low-poly primitives that rotate slowly and bob on independent offsets. Suited to feature or process sections that benefit from a calm, spatial backdrop.

scenes.name: Molecule graph
scenes.description: Nodes linked by edges, with gentle spring motion between them. Uses the accent token for nodes and the border token for bonds to explain connected or networked ideas.

scenes.name: Cross section
scenes.description: A layered solid sliced on a plane so the internal structure is visible. Highlights an inner layer with the accent token, useful for explaining what is inside a system.

scenes.name: Flow along a curve
scenes.description: Particles travelling along a defined spline from start to end, with speed and loop count configurable. Reads as a pipeline, journey or data flow.

scenes.name: Glow
scenes.description: A soft emissive object with a large falloff and a slow pulse. Kept low contrast so foreground headings built from the type scale stay fully readable.
